question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Indigent
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Indigent"** means someone who is very poor and lacking the basic resources of life. (गरीब)

 
 
• **Example: **Many **indigent **families are unable to afford adequate shelter and food.
 
 
 
• **"Impoverished" **refers to someone who has been made poor or is in a state of poverty. (निर्धन)
 
 
• **Example: **The **impoverished** community struggled to rebuild after the natural disaster.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'Indigent' **is **'Impoverished'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bust **(तोड़ना): To break something apart or to fail financially.

 
 
• **Example:** The company went bust after the financial crisis.
 
 
 
• **Low **(निम्न): At a small height or amount.
 
 
• **Example: **The water level in the river is very low this year.
 
 
 
• **Affluent **(धनी): Having a great deal of money; wealthy.
 
 
• **Example:** They live in an affluent neighborhood with large houses and expensive cars.
